description: PomoDial is a Pomodoro focus timer that asks what you're working on before the clock starts. Tell ChatGPT your intention, start a timed session, and PomoDial tracks your focus history, streaks, and progress. Sessions sync with your account at pomodial.com where you can view your intention journal, unlock dial faces, and compete on the leaderboard.

defaultPrompt: "Show me my productivity summary and focus streak"
"I just finished my focus session, mark it complete"
